editorial.description_en: The last depth at which anything is still blue rather than simply dark.
editorial.description_ja: 海の底のような、いちばん深いところの青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.348, C 0.096, h 250.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 底 (soko, bottom) + 海 (umi, sea). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Sea Floor" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 底海. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — fuyu-yo at ΔE00 6.3, yoru-giri at ΔE00 8.0, hoshi-nashi at ΔE00 9.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (70°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
